FAQ

cPanel, HTTPS Security, DNS & Database Issues

Still have questions?

Talk to a specialist — 24/7, nationwide.

Call Now - Have Questions!
What is HTTPS security, and why is it important?

HTTPS encrypts data between your website and its visitors, ensuring privacy and protection from malicious attacks.
Enabling HTTPS through an SSL certificate improves trust, protects user data, and is now a key ranking factor in Google’s algorithm.

Can you help me install or fix an SSL certificate through cPanel?

Yes, we can.
We install, renew, or troubleshoot SSL certificates through cPanel to ensure your website displays the secure padlock icon and loads properly over HTTPS.

Why is my website showing a “Not Secure” warning?

This usually means your site doesn’t have a valid SSL certificate or some page elements are still loading over HTTP.
We identify the cause, install or update your SSL, and ensure all content is properly secured.

What are DNS errors, and how do they affect my site?

DNS errors occur when domain name settings are misconfigured or unreachable.
These issues can cause your website to go offline or display errors like “Server Not Found.” We correct DNS records, name server settings, and ensure proper domain resolution.

Can you fix issues with my domain not pointing to the correct site?

Yes.
We review and update your DNS zone files and name servers to ensure your domain connects to the right hosting account and loads your site properly.

What causes database errors on WordPress websites?

Common causes include corrupted tables, incorrect login credentials, missing database connections, or server overloads.
These can lead to errors like “Error Establishing a Database Connection.” We troubleshoot, repair, or restore your database to full functionality.

Can you restore a broken database?

Absolutely.
We take backups, repair corrupted tables, restore lost data if available, and get your website back online quickly and securely.

Do you offer full repair for both server and site-level issues?

Yes, we do.
From cPanel-level fixes and DNS corrections to database repairs and HTTPS setup, we provide complete technical support to keep your site secure, fast, and functional.

How do I get started?

Call us at 832-266-7209, or submit your info.
We’ll provide a free consultation, assess your site, and start the process with a full backup and a secure plan.
